requirements.english_requirement: MUET Band 3 or IELTS 5.5 required for candidates with Grades D/E in English at SPM/O-Level.
requirements.other_qualifications: Pass SPM/O-Level with minimum 3 credits (Grade C) including Mathematics, one Science/Technical/Engineering subject and one additional subject, and English (Grade E); or UEC with minimum 3 subjects Grade B6 including Mathematics and one Science/Technical/Engineering subject; or SVM/SKM/Engineering Technology Certificate Level 3 (CGPA 2.00) or equivalent; international applicants require a High School Certificate with minimum 50% (Arab Saudi/MENA) or Grade C (overseas) in Mathematics and Physics.
